step1.titulo_cuanto_cuesta: How much does car insurance cost?
step1.texto_cuanto_cuesta: To find out how much your car insurance costs, it is necessary to calculate the price beforehand, as there is no single, identical price for everyone. The amount you pay for your car insurance depends on your car model, your driver profile, and other factors such as the coverage type you choose (third-party, extended third-party, and comprehensive) or the inclusion of optional coverages in the policy.
step1.texto_ventajas: Welcome to the car insurance simulator, a fast tool designed to give you a quote for your car insurance. In just a few minutes, you will get your price in the most convenient way. Don't wait any longer and take advantage of calculating your car insurance online:
ventajas_lista: • Save time. We know that people's time is highly valuable, which is why we want to provide you with the fastest and simplest way to calculate your car insurance. All in short steps and from wherever you want.
• You decide. By using our car insurance simulator, you will have total discretion when making your final decision. Evaluate the price and coverages, and decide.

• Easy to use. In each step, we visually display the different answer options. In this case, the main star is your vehicle, so the only fundamental requirement to get a car insurance quote is knowing the model.
• Run the simulation as many times as you need. It doesn't matter if you made a mistake with a data entry; you can repeat the process.
• Save your price. If you wish, once you have your car insurance quote, we will send you an email with a link so you can download your price and won't have to calculate it again.

faqs_calcular.q: How to calculate car insurance online with Caser Seguros?
faqs_calcular.a: Calculating car insurance online with Caser Seguros is very easy. To do so, you only need to know some basic details about your vehicle, such as the model and the year of registration, as well as others related to your driving license, such as the date of issue.

faqs_calcular.q: Can I calculate the price of car insurance for all available coverage types?
faqs_calcular.a: The car insurance simulator is designed to give you all possible options in the easiest way, so at the end of the process, we automatically calculate the price for all those coverages that best suit your vehicle.

faqs_calcular.q: Can I include a second driver during my car insurance simulation process?
faqs_calcular.a: You can add a second driver in the online application form after viewing the price.

faqs_calcular.q: Once I get a price, am I obligated to purchase?
faqs_calcular.a: Absolutely not. Using our simulator does not commit you to anything with us. If the options we provide fit what you are looking for, you can choose to purchase later.

faqs_calcular.q: How do I save my price?
faqs_calcular.a: Once you finish your car insurance simulation, we give you the option to provide your email address so we can send you the prices obtained for each coverage type.

faqs_calcular.q: Why am I asked for my ID (DNI) to save my price?
faqs_calcular.a: We request your ID to save your quote in our database and associate it with your profile. But remember, getting your price does not imply purchasing.

faqs_calcular.q: What factors influence calculating car insurance online?
faqs_calcular.a:
There are different factors that influence when calculating the price of your car insurance. Some of them are the following:

• Your characteristics as a driver: age, accident history, years holding a license, province where you live...
• Your car features: age, engine, do you have a garage parking space?...
• Selected coverage type: basic third-party, extended third-party, or comprehensive.

faqs_contratar.q: What data do I need for the car insurance purchase process?
faqs_contratar.a: You will only need some basic contact details.

faqs_contratar.q: Can I split the car insurance payment into installments?
faqs_contratar.a: Yes. You can split your premium payment as long as it exceeds €100 per receipt. You can do it on an annual, semi-annual, or quarterly basis.

faqs_contratar.q: Can I use the insurance from the same day I purchase it?
faqs_contratar.a: You can use your insurance from the exact day and hour of the policy's effective date.

faqs_contratar.q: Do I need to provide banking details when purchasing online?
faqs_contratar.a: Yes, because your insurance payment is made via direct debit.

faqs_contratar.q: Once my car insurance is purchased, will I receive any documentation by email?
faqs_contratar.a: A few minutes after purchasing, you will receive a link in your email to sign and download your documentation. This process is very easy, as we will send an SMS to your mobile phone to sign. You will be able to download your general conditions, policy schedule, and green card.
